shortDescription: Greece's ELVO - Hellenic Vehicle Industries, a manufacturer of specialised military and civilian vehicles, said on Friday it was investing €40 million to expand and modernise its defence manufacturing capabilities.

children: Greece's ELVO - Hellenic Vehicle Industries, a manufacturer of specialised military and civilian vehicles, said on Friday it was investing €40 million to expand and modernise its defence manufacturing capabilities.
ELVO is a unit of Israel's SK Group.
The investment comes after Israel signed a $3.5 billion air defence deal with Greece this week.

ELVO said the investment would strengthen its existing military vehicle production while expanding its capabilities to manufacture additional defence systems and conduct R&D, as well as incorporate SK Group's technologies into ELVO’s systems portfolio, including unmanned aerial systems and anti-drone systems.
It will also create about 300 new jobs at its Sindos facility in northern Greece.
SK Group has already invested more than €20 million to restructure the company and upgrade its facilities.
